entities.summary: Cartoonito is a Middle Eastern pay television children's channel broadcast in the Middle East, Greece, Cyprus, Turkey and North and Sub-Saharan Africa. It originally launched as a programming block on 12 October 2011, before it launched independent channel feeds on 1 July 2016, and replaced Boomerang in some markets in 2023. The channel is part of the Cartoonito brand owned by Warner Bros. Discovery and its EMEA arm.
